ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a circle centered at F, and A, B, C, D, E are all on the circumference. It can be seen from the figure that FB and FE are on the same straight line and in opposite directions, so BE is a diameter. The figure marks ∠AFE = 63° at the center F, that is, the central angle between radii FA and FE is 63°. Reasoning: Because FB and FE are opposite rays, ∠AFB and ∠AFE are supplementary angles. Therefore m∠AFB = 180° - 63° = 117°. The central angle ∠AFB corresponds to minor arc AB, so the measure of minor arc AB is 117°. The problem asks for m arc ADB, that is, the arc from A to B that passes through D, which is the other major arc. Therefore m arc ADB = 360° - 117° = 243°.

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as a circle centered at F with points A, B, C, D, E on the circumference. From the image, FE and FB lie on the same straight line through F, so BE is a diameter, and the central angle between FA and FE is labeled 63°. Therefore the central angle between FA and FB is supplementary to 63°, so m∠AFB = 180° - 63° = 117°. This equals the measure of the minor arc AB. The requested arc ADB is the other arc from A to B passing through D, so its measure is 360° - 117° = 243°.
method.CoT_raw:

推理：因为 FB 与 FE 是相反射线，所以 ∠AFB 与 ∠AFE 互为补角。因此 m∠AFB = 180° - 63° = 117°。中心角 ∠AFB 对应小弧 AB，所以小弧 AB 的度数是 117°。题目要求 m弧 ADB，即从 A 到 B 且经过 D 的那条弧，是另一条大弧。因此 m弧 ADB = 360° - 117° = 243°。

planner_metadata.image_role: The image provides the circle centered at F, the collinearity of B-F-E as a diameter, the central angle ∠AFE = 63°, and that D lies on the major arc from A to B.

planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use that a central angle equals its intercepted arc, angles forming a straight line sum to 180°, and the two arcs between the same endpoints sum to 360°.
